summary: Improving Travel for Military Members Act This bill allows the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) to establish a pilot program to expedite access to security screening for traveling active-duty military personnel and accompanying family members. In selecting airports to participate in the pilot program, TSA must give priority to airports in proximity to certain military installations.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
